method: Each run: fresh bare origin and two clones; change A is opened as a PR on laptop A; the agent starts on laptop B; A is approved by simulated humans and merged after the agent's first tool call (fallback 20s); the agent's uncommitted work is committed by the runner; the branch is tested alone, opened as a PR, and integrated: every arm but baseline through the real gate and guardian, baseline through raw Git. Arms: baseline (hooks off); harness; vague (the same hooks deliver a non-specific warning); stop-only (no notes during the task, only the Stop gate); notes-only (notes, no Stop gate). Hooks fetch at most every 5s in this evaluation (default 60s) because the task takes about a minute.
